special_policies.name: auth_lookup
special_policies.using:
((current_setting('tetral.auth_lookup'::text, true) = 'true'::text) AND (CURRENT_USER = ( SELECT pg_get_userbyid(pg_class.relowner) AS pg_get_userbyid
   FROM pg_class
  WHERE (pg_class.oid = ('api_keys'::regclass)::oid))))
special_policies.check:
((current_setting('tetral.auth_lookup'::text, true) = 'true'::text) AND (CURRENT_USER = ( SELECT pg_get_userbyid(pg_class.relowner) AS pg_get_userbyid
   FROM pg_class
  WHERE (pg_class.oid = ('api_keys'::regclass)::oid))))
